compiled_state.title: RED: tests for parent_status_uuid in STATUS events written by ticket-transition.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
testing_mode: RED

Write failing tests for parent_status_uuid field in STATUS events. Tests must be RED before T11 implementation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given: ticket just created (no prior STATUS events); When: first transition called; Then: new STATUS event JSON contains parent_status_uuid field set to JSON null (not absent — the field must always be present)
- Given: ticket with one prior STATUS event (file: abc123...json); When: second transition called; Then: new STATUS event has parent_status_uuid == 'abc123...' (UUID of prior event file, without .json extension)
- Given: ticket with two prior STATUS events; When: third transition; Then: parent_status_uuid == UUID of second STATUS event (most recent, not first)
- Given: any STATUS event; When: event JSON parsed; Then: parent_status_uuid key is always present (never omitted)

Semantic clarification: parent_status_uuid is always present in every STATUS event. First-in-chain events have JSON null (not missing field). Subsequent events carry the UUID filename (without .json) of the immediately preceding STATUS event.

Test file: tests/scripts/test-ticket-transition.sh (add new test functions)
Story DD coverage: SC6 (parent_status_uuid chain)
Retry budget: 2 attempts

comments.body:
GAP_AC_AMENDMENT: Pre-migration STATUS events without parent_status_uuid field.
Additional AC: tests must also cover the mixed-schema window — when ticket has existing STATUS events that predate T11 (no parent_status_uuid field), ticket-transition.sh must treat those legacy events as chain roots. The new event's parent_status_uuid must point to the UUID of the most recent prior STATUS event regardless of whether that event has the field itself. Test: create ticket, write a legacy STATUS event (without parent_status_uuid), then call transition — assert new STATUS event has parent_status_uuid = UUID of the legacy event.
